tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions as per tender documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Copies of Supply Orders/Performance Certificate/Satisfactory Order Delivery Certificates from the Authority concerned must be enclosed for supply, installation and demonstration of the similar equipments to the Educational Institutions.

Bidder should be a Firm/Company/Proprietary/Partnership/LLP/Pvt. Ltd./business entities registered under law in force in India and declaration should be submitted in format Also, the Certificate of Registration should be enclosed
Details of Active Taxpayers GST Registration and GST Clearance Certificates for the last three years should be enclosed.

The Bidder must be a reputed supplier/manufacturer/authorized dealer/authorized distributor/authorized stockiest/channel partner in the business of supply, installation and demonstration of similar equipments for a period not less than 3 years. The certificate of incorporation or any other relevant certificate to this effect should be enclosed.
IT Returns for the last 3 years i.e., should be enclosed. i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26.

Bidders should submit copies of audited Statement of Accounts and Annual Turnover Certificate issued by Charted Accountant for the last three years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26, for having achieved on an average of Rs. 200 lakhs turnover.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Copy of PAN Card issued by I.T Department, Full address and telephone number of the office of the Assessing Authority under the GST should be provided.
The bidder should submit the Name of the Firm, Name of Proprietor/Managing Director, Full Address and Contact Number on the Company Letter head.

The Certificate/Dealership Authorization letter for the branded items quoted, issued by Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEM) for having appointed the bidders as the authorized seller/distributor of their support for the vendor during the equipment warranty period in format
The Manufacturers Quality Control Certificate should be accompanied with final products and it should be ISO certified. The bidder should produce Valid ISO Certificate.
